milestones.name: Acquire Dream Nail
milestones.note: Required to fight Elder Hu's spirit at his memorial

milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Spirit shatters into 100 Essence collected by the Dream Nail

milestones.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
milestones.note: Awarded upon defeating Elder Hu's spirit

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Hub town, old well leading to Forgotten Crossroads, Stag Station, few remaining travellers

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Gates above which Elder Hu's memorial is erected

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where Elder Hu was killed by the Mantis Tribe

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.fingerprintHint: Location of large dead Husk Dandy corpse holding Love Key

zones.name: King's Pass
zones.fingerprintHint: Entry route to Dirtmouth from the surface; bridge eventually crumbled

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Accessible via the old well in Dirtmouth

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.grants: Fight spirits of the dead; collect Essence; read Dream dialogue on corpses
abilities.note: Required to fight Elder Hu; also used to Dream Nail the Husk Dandy corpse in Queen's Gardens

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.note: Highly recommended but not required for Elder Hu fight; useful against Ring Slam

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Spell used in recommended Spell build against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.note: Upgraded spell used in recommended Spell build against Elder Hu

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.note: Held by the large dead Husk Dandy corpse in Queen's Gardens

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Spirit fought at his memorial above the gates to the City of Tears; requires Dream Nail to trigger. Attacks: Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, Teleport. Drops 100 Essence.

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu's spirit
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to Elder Hu's memorial above the gates to the City of Tears and use the Dream Nail to engage his spirit
objectives.note: Requires Dream Nail to be acquired first

objectives.name: Collect Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat Elder Hu to collect 100 Essence with the Dream Nail

objectives.name: Dream Nail the Husk Dandy corpse
objectives.hopDescription: Locate the large dead Husk Dandy holding the Love Key in Queen's Gardens and use the Dream Nail on it
objectives.note: Provides lore dialogue: 'Too long... spent together. We become as one...'

objectives.name: Enter Hallownest via the well
objectives.hopDescription: Descend into Dirtmouth's old well to reach the Forgotten Crossroads and the ruins of Hallownest
